role: Bounded development fixtures for one fixed untrained request heuristic; not validation, test, field accuracy or a promotion decision
hypothesis: Fresh surround rays and independent body-motion screening may trigger turning/escape before the unchanged R2 guard must force neutral. Seven navigation requests, no motor-derived measured velocity or hidden coordinates.
method: Subtract positive measured ray velocity projection plus declared engineering margin over a fixed screening horizon. This is not a certified predicted distance or TTC. Pivot away from the limiting direction; if hazard is rearward and front screening is clear, request FORWARD. Use original allowed mask and independent R2 guards.
reference: Frozen navigationBaseline rules_with_hold, same source sensors/physics/original mask and common operator/stream-fault overrides; reference does not exploit candidate history
default_plant: Unchanged R2 noise/dropouts/gain generator/current/inertia/guards/960-step natural outcome. Only explicitly listed deterministic fixture geometry/current/delay overrides; no zero-noise evaluation profile.

common_overrides: If recorder faults or observed ACK is inconsistent/after-window/invalid-ledger: STOP when allowed, otherwise null. Operator STOP interval overrides both. Manual/disarm remain enforced by original R2. No command lifetime extension.
rollout: Every fixture/controller runs until original collection, collision or960-step timeout. Assistance/recording failure is not early termination. All28outcomes remain in denominators.
capture: Aggregate original outcomes/guard-near-stop/applied-output integrity; bounded complete sidecar last12records plus at most3first-event windows and associated proposal reasons per episode. No full historical training reconstruction.
mechanics_gates: All new deterministic selector tests pass
No action outside original seven-request mask except explicit null absence
No nonzero applied outputs under manual/disarm/operator STOP or scheduled range loss
decision: Passing development gates permits research design review only, never deployment or automatic training. On failure close this version and inspect saved evidence; no parameter sweep, rerun or extra epochs.
